# Issue
Currently when trying to join some worlds in Vrchat you are hit by the error "You cannot access this world." 
This has happened to me in:
-Friends+ Instance (Community Meetup)
-Public instances (Great Pug and Open Mic Night)
If the user is on orange it just send you back to your home world. However some users have reported that low end hardware crashes the game instead of joining their home world. (Though I cannot replicate this.)

comments.value:
Looks like updating to the new beta, 1226, has fixed it for me - 5/5 successful world changes.
I'm wondering, though, what was the reason? Why was i afaik the only person in my local community of tens of people actively playing VRC in the meantime who experienced this? Especially that it definitely wasn't "rare" as the changelog suggests. "only a few people have this issue constantly" is not the same as "this issue happens rarely".

We're pretty sure that this issue is fixed in the latest open beta, however we weren't able to reliably reproduce it ourselves because it only affected a small number of users. Please try the beta again and let us know if you're still having issues!
We'll re-open this post if anyone is still having it.
